sources.title: LiteRT.js, Google's high performance Web AI Inference
sources.keyClaim: LiteRT.js = JS binding of native LiteRT runtime compiled to Wasm; 3 backends (XNNPACK/WASM, ML Drift/WebGPU, WebNN); up to 3x faster than web runtimes.

sources.title: LiteRT for Web with LiteRT.js
sources.keyClaim: Features: in-browser HW-accelerated inference, multi-framework (PyTorch/JAX/TF) conversion, TF.js integration. Install @litertjs/core; Wasm in node_modules/@litertjs/core/wasm/.

sources.title: Get started with LiteRT.js
sources.keyClaim: WebGPU/WebNN init code; JSPI required for WebNN and model partitioning; getWebGpuDevice for TFJS interop; OS/arch support limits (Win DirectML, Mac Apple Silicon, Linux OpenVINO).

sources.title: LiteRT.js core README (GitHub)
sources.keyClaim: Full API: loadLiteRt, loadAndCompile(model,{accelerator}), Tensor, moveTo, delete. Limits: 2GB Wasm CPU cap; non-JSPI => whole-model WASM fallback; manual tensor memory.

sources.title: LiteRT.js README (GitHub litert/js)
sources.keyClaim: Usage with TFJS; model-tester for GPU delegation + numerical parity; pre/post-processing left to user or TF.js.

sources.title: LiteRT-LM Web API (JS)
sources.keyClaim: Separate package @litert-lm/core for in-browser LLMs (Gemma 4 E2B/E4B). Engine.create({model}); createConversation(); sendMessageStreaming(). Early preview, WebGPU text-in/out.

sources.title: LiteRT-LM JS API README (GitHub)
sources.keyClaim: REPL chat sample using @litert-lm/core from CDN; supported models gemma-4-E2B/E4B-it-web.litertlm.

sources.title: @litertjs/core on npm
sources.keyClaim: Package provides core load/run of .tflite in browser with WebGPU+CPU. Latest 0.2.1 (early release).

sources.title: @litertjs/tfjs-interop on npm
sources.keyClaim: Convert tensors between LiteRT.js and TF.js; runWithTfjsTensors wrapper.

sources.title: @litertjs/model-tester on npm
sources.keyClaim: Validate GPU delegation coverage and numerical diff vs CPU.

sources.title: Browser AI 2026: On-Device Models with WebGPU & LiteRT.js
sources.keyClaim: Backend ladder: CPU/XNNPACK, GPU/ML Drift WebGPU, NPU/WebNN. Getting-started snippet; Kaggle + HF model sources.

sources.title: LiteRT.js: Run AI Models in the Browser, No Server
sources.keyClaim: 5-60x vs CPU with WebGPU; WebNN experimental, Win11 24H2+, don't ship prod; perf on M4 MacBook Pro.

sources.title: Google Releases LiteRT.js for WebGPU .tflite Inference
sources.keyClaim: Native runtime vs JS kernels; dispatch rules: no partial delegation; JSPI enables per-op partitioning.

sources.title: Google LiteRT.js Brings AI Inference to Browsers
sources.keyClaim: QA surface: cross-browser coverage, fallback-path assertions, performance-as-correctness. Package @litertjs/core.

sources.title: LiteRT.js: On-Device AI Inference in Web Browsers
sources.keyClaim: Benefits: privacy, zero server cost, low latency; limit: requires .tflite conversion.

sources.title: LiteRT.js: Google's Runtime for Near-Native AI Inference
sources.keyClaim: LiteRT formerly TFLite; JS binding compiled to Wasm with clean JS/TS API.

sources.title: Export YOLO to LiteRT (TFLite) for Edge and Web
sources.keyClaim: @ultralytics/yolo + @litertjs/core runs YOLO .tflite in browser with WebGPU + CPU/WASM fallback; ~2x faster than ONNX Runtime Web.

sources.title: JavaScript and WebAssembly API (LiteRT)
sources.keyClaim: Architecture: JS->Wasm bridge; loadLiteRt feature-detects SIMD/Threads/JSPI, loads matching wasm pair; Environment class manages WebGPU device.
